assignments.value:
I've spent the last stretch building things that run without me.

Four n8n workflows, published and running:

• A scheduled AI agent that reads the day's important emails, filters job alerts against my criteria and checks tomorrow's calendar, then writes me a briefing on Telegram. Last run: 36.9s.

• Two webhook-driven order CRMs that validate every order field by field, confirm by email, and append anything malformed to an audit log instead of failing silently.

• Invoice intake and finance approval across Zapier, Google Sheets and Forms, with currency routing and duplicate checks.

Plus HOMEBODY — a storefront I designed, built and deployed end to end, where discount codes are validated server-side so one customer can't reuse them.

It's all in one place now:
{{PORTFOLIO_URL}}

Open to automation, AI agent and web design work.
